indicator_name: Credit-to-GDP, Basel III credit-to-GDP gap, credit impulse, real credit growth (computed by this repository)
description: Кредиты к ВВП, разрыв кредит/ВВП по Базелю III, кредитный импульс, реальный рост кредитов (расчёт репозитория)
methodology: Credit: BANK_LOANS_STB_TOTAL (bank loans to the economy, stock as at the 1st, taken at the 1st of the next quarter = end of the quarter); GDP: QNA_GDP_EXPENDITURE item GDP, nominal, sum of the last four quarters. Gap: ratio less its one-sided HP trend, lambda 400 000 (BCBS 2010), from the 12th quarter. Impulse: (credit flow over four quarters - the same a year earlier) / four-quarter GDP (Biggs, Mayer, Pick 2010). Real growth deflates y/y growth by CPI_YOY of the quarter's last month. Bank credit only (no non-bank, no external borrowing): narrower than the BIS total-credit gap.
